source: Team27 Research Page.docx, Yimeng section and exercise notes
disclaimer: Transcribed team research notes for a class prototype. These are not clinically validated thresholds.

formula_notes: Research note: relative squat depth is y displacement divided by height.
Runtime minimum depth is 32.1% minus a 3 percentage point tolerance = 29.1% (0.291).
Runtime maximum hip/waist return drift is 0.48% + 0.02% = 0.50% (0.005).
Runtime maximum head return drift is 0.163% + 0.006% = 0.169% (0.00169).
Runtime estimates height from detected nose-to-ankle image distance; this is a prototype approximation, not the same measurement setup as the research source.

plank.note: Angle vertex/side-view convention and hold duration need to be confirmed before adding this mode.

bicep_curl.note: These are endpoint cues from the notes; the repetition start/end transition is not specified.

arm_rainbow.note: The notes say to check upright posture, arm angle, and front/back camera orientation but provide no numeric threshold.

farmers_carry.note: The notes specify an upright torso angle under 8 degrees; duration and rep/event rules are unspecified.

good_morning.note: The source notes do not fully define the angle convention or how the two tests combine.
